resource_note: One wave of30 single-thread workers on32 verified CPUs,2free; each710s training+180s diagnostics+10s cleanup;1100s global;120s setup. No GPU/local training.
comparison_note: Paired reruns from the same Gaussian seeds, not checkpoint continuation and not fresh-seed confirmation. Existing v7 runs remain controls; explicit horizon/stop/scale/head-rate changes only. Intercept/normalization/quadrature/step cap unchanged.
criterion: Same checkpoint inside initial1%/5% all-update loss prefixes; Amin gain>=.5; unchanged original AGOP screens; numerical lower refit gain>=.1VarY; later rawloss drop>=.1VarY. Censoring and numerical uncertainty retained.
